statuses.title: Send a message when an order
statuses.description: `placed` (a new order) or the status keys of the lifecycle.

channels.title: Channels, in order of preference
channels.description: The first channel the customer can be reached on is used: email needs an e-mail address, sms and whatsapp a phone number.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: Per status, language and channel (`any` = every channel). Placeholders: {brand}, {name}, {number}, {status}, {total}, {carrier}, {tracking_number}, {tracking_url}, {reason}. Statuses without a template use the product's default text in the customer's language.

brand.title: Sender name in messages ({brand})
brand.description: Empty = the invoice business name, else the website's domain.

delivery.title: How messages leave
delivery.description: connector (your messaging connector sends them) or event (publish orders.customer_update@1 for a messaging product to send).
